Build a production-quality demo marketing website for a real local commercial janitorial business in Siloam Springs, AR. Get a facilities manager, GC or purchasing agent to submit a request for quote with a drawing or a site address attached. I will show it to the owner in a sales conversation, so it must look finished and be honest about what is real.

Constraints — do not break these
1. Invent nothing. No fabricated reviews, testimonials, client names, licence numbers, years in business, awards, certifications, insurance details or statistics. Where I have not supplied content, render a visible placeholder such as [REVIEW 1 — pull from Google profile] rather than plausible filler.
2. Use only the images I supply. No stock photography, no AI-generated photos of work. Anything missing stays on public/placeholder.svg.
3. Render a small line in the footer: "Demo site — not affiliated with {Business Name}." I remove it once they pay.
4. Do not use their logo unless I supply the file. Set the wordmark in type instead.
5. Do not add analytics, tracking pixels, cookie banners or third-party scripts to the demo.
6. No horizontal page scroll at any viewport from 320px up.
7. Never publish a client name, logo or project figure without my confirmation that we are allowed to use it. B2B references are usually contractual.
8. Do not state insurance limits, bonding capacity, EMR or certifications I have not supplied.
9. No stock photography anywhere on this site. If I have not supplied a photo, leave a marked placeholder instead.
10. Do not fork the theme system. If this trade genuinely needs a colour the palette lacks, tell me and propose a different themeId — never hard-code a hex in a component.

Copy direction
- Headline formula: the offering plus the city, plainly. The home page targets the phrase "commercial cleaning company Siloam Springs".
- Tone: Friendly, specific, price-transparent. Remove every reason to hesitate.
- Plain English, short sentences, no marketing adjectives, no "we pride ourselves on".
- Every call to action offers the same two options: "Request a quote" or "Download capabilities".
- Write real FAQ answers for this specific trade. Where a number is required and I have not supplied it, use a bracketed placeholder.

Style
themeId 'C28' — Fresh Fern, light. For reference the palette resolves to bg #F7FBF3, surface #FFFFFF, text #22301D, muted #71816A, accent #4E9E3D, positive #4E9E3D, negative #C13440; type Soft Rounded (Nunito or Quicksand). The template owns these values — consume them through its tokens, never restate them.
Accent is for calls to action only; positive and negative stay semantic.
Design register for this category: Plain and specification-led. Tables over hero images, capacities over adjectives, and no stock photography at all.

Technical requirements
- Mobile-first. Design for a 390px phone held one-handed, then scale up.
- Lighthouse mobile: performance 90+, accessibility 95+. LCP under 2.5s on simulated slow 4G.
- All images through next/image with explicit sizes, priority on the hero only, lazy below the fold.
- Extend the template's JSON-LD to: ProfessionalService or LocalBusiness with areaServed and makesOffer, plus Organization with legalName.
- Text contrast 4.5:1 minimum, visible :focus-visible rings, real alt text, one h1 per route, prefers-reduced-motion respected.

Done when
- pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint and pnpm build all pass clean, and pnpm dev runs with no console errors or hydration warnings.
- Changing site.config.ts alone swaps the business name, city, phone, hours and theme everywhere, with no component edits.
- /style-guide renders the chosen theme and /demo-shots renders the new sections.
- Every unsupplied fact renders as a visible bracketed placeholder — searching the built page for "[" finds all of them.
- The RFQ form accepts a file upload and returns a success state with a reference number.
- The capabilities table renders as a real table on desktop and stays readable at 390px with no horizontal page scroll.

Size of the ask
Do not do this in one pass. Four reviewable steps, stop and report after each:
1. Create from the template, pnpm install, read CLAUDE.md, fill site.config.ts including themeId 'C28', confirm /style-guide.
2. Adapt the 6 reused template sections to this business, static content only.
3. Build the 5 new section components and wire the b2b request for quote flow end to end through deliverContactForm().
4. Add the remaining routes, extend the JSON-LD, then a Lighthouse pass and fixes.

clips:
Goal
Build a production-quality demo marketing website for a real local commercial janitorial business in Siloam Springs, AR. Get a facilities manager, GC or purchasing agent to submit a request for quote with a drawing or a site address attached. I will show it to the owner in a sales conversation, so it must look finished and be honest about what is real.

Start from my template — do not scaffold a new project
Template repo: https://github.com/manzoorilahi77/base-website
README: https://github.com/manzoorilahi77/base-website/blob/main/README.md

Create the project from it, then stop and report before writing any code:
  gh repo create siloamsprings-commercialjani-{business-slug} --template manzoorilahi77/base-website
  # or, without gh:
  # git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/manzoorilahi77/base-website.git siloamsprings-commercialjani-{business-slug}
  # cd siloamsprings-commercialjani-{business-slug} && rm -rf .git && git init -b main && git add -A && git commit -m "Initial commit from base-website"
  cd siloamsprings-commercialjani-{business-slug} && pnpm install && pnpm dev

Read CLAUDE.md (symlinked as AGENTS.md) in the repo root first and follow it. Where it contradicts anything below, CLAUDE.md wins — tell me about the conflict rather than silently picking one.

Constraints — do not break these
1. Invent nothing. No fabricated reviews, testimonials, client names, licence numbers, years in business, awards, certifications, insurance details or statistics. Where I have not supplied content, render a visible placeholder such as [REVIEW 1 — pull from Google profile] rather than plausible filler.

10. Do not fork the theme system. If this trade genuinely needs a colour the palette lacks, tell me and propose a different themeId — never hard-code a hex in a component.

- Headline formula: the offering plus the city, plainly. The home page targets the phrase "commercial cleaning company Siloam Springs".
- Tone: Friendly, specific, price-transparent. Remove every reason to hesitate.
- Plain English, short sentences, no marketing adjectives, no "we pride ourselves on".
- Every call to action offers the same two options: "Request a quote" or "Download capabilities".
- Write real FAQ answers for this specific trade. Where a number is required and I have not supplied it, use a bracketed placeholder.
